payload.description_html:
Agilisaurus multidens

Symtemtic position: Fabrosauridae, Ornithopoda, Ornithischia. Locality: Dashanpu, Zigong, Sichuan, China. Age: Middle Jurassic (about 160 million years ago).

This is a small ornithopod dinosaur preserved in its burial condition about 1.4m long. Its small skull bears short snout and numerous leaf-like teeth. The forelimbs are very short while the hindlimbs are long. This is a well-preserved specimen including a complete skull.
